title: Location
description: D6 (docs/ontology/DECISIONS.md): Location is a first-class entity in the schema from day one, not a bare string attribute on a device -- defaults to 'cabin' when omitted, since that's every device's implicit home before Home comes fully online. Deliberately minimal: this is a Sprint 1 stub so device-reporting-relationship.schema.json has a real $ref target, not a full migration of the existing DeviceStatus.location string attribute (that migration is out of scope for Sprint 1 -- see DECISIONS.md's D6 status note).

location_id.description: The two locations this platform currently spans. Not an open enum yet -- extend when a third location is actually onboarded, not speculatively.

area.description: Sub-location dimension per the axioms ('Location... and Area are first-class dimensions') -- e.g. mech_room, kitchen. Currently only exists informally baked into device names (temp_mech_room); not a queryable field anywhere yet. Nullable because most devices don't have one assigned today.
